title: pm-dispatch: execution-duties says a narrowing card is Clause-② no, AGENTS.md allows yes (narrowing): align the declaration rule
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: two rule texts disagree on how a PR that both narrows a published accept set and widens a public surface declares `Clause-②`. Seen by L1 on PR #34753 (comment 6946488378). Dedupe: `Clause-② narrowing declaration`; no open card.

Suggested-grade: p3 · domain:skills · tooling

## The two texts

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` (around line 116 on main): 「收窄已发布接受集的卡是 `Clause-②: no`,不移车道;入队前欠一次契约审核档 L2 审核。」
- `AGENTS.md` and the dispatch template allow `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` for a change that narrows.

PR #34753 narrows one path (a resume answered 200 now answers 409) and adds an optional public key, and declared `yes (narrowing)`; PR #34750 narrows only and declared `no (narrowing)`. Both readings passed L1 and L2, so the declaration is not mechanically decidable from the texts today.

## What is wanted

Align the two texts in one place (which arm a narrowing-plus-widening PR writes, and whether `no (narrowing)` and `yes (narrowing)` are both legal), and point the other at it. Text only; no gate change.
